lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Large, high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns along the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits. Centroids maintain a roughly equidistant 2D spatial distribution within each vertical row.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a repetitive grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition from highlight on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct high-density clustering of smaller, lower-luminance spots on the dorsal-frontal head region, contrasting with the larger, sparser maculae on the lateral body.
